newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market mostly steady - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market mostly steady - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers mostly steady, compared to Wednesday's close, USDA said. Trade moderate. Demand moderate. Seller interest light to moderate. Offerings current.
